name: Toi
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy

points: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer, he sent his son Joram to salute and bless David, because Hadadezer had had wars with Toi. Joram brought vessels of silver, gold, and brass.
Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten the host of Hadarezer and sent his son to greet David and congratulate him.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 18: The Victories of King David
